ThingDef.label: Arayashiki (Sheathed)
ThingDef.description: A partially translucent ōdachi. Arayashiki's scabbard is a viable form of weapon.\n\nArayashiki is an extraordinarily rare Relic that inflicts cuts that can never be made whole again. The wounds it causes will always burn painfully and reopen once the individual is back in the presence of Arayashiki, even after the cuts are given the chance to heal. This includes inorganic material such as prostheses and metal, which will begin to fall apart in the way they'd been slashed originally. Using this Relic comes at the cost of mutilating the memories of its user, starting with the most precious or recent of them. If there are no more memories, it takes skills, and then traits once skills can't pay the cost.
